eval_feedback: Showcase with_skill run on the gen-3 pure-holdout existing-system scenario — all four signature traps resolved and the two axes that break the FAIL anchors both handled correctly. Scope trap: cancellation scoped admin-side with customer self-service excluded, grounded to README:11's no-login fact via territory (the correct D3 path for a project-derivable fact) rather than wasting a question on it. Refund integration: 무통장입금-only, manual banking-app transfer recorded in ledger.csv, no PG/card API invented, traced to the R1.Q2 refund-handling question with the owner-manual premise sourced to README:7-8. Cancel boundary: 발송 전(pending_payment/paid/preparing) only, shipped/delivered out of scope, landed via R1.Q1. Partial cancel: interviewer-raised in R2.Q1 off the real multi-item ORD-1021, landed as a decision with the refund amount shown (54000=2×22000+2×5000, 머그 1개=22000 verified against orders.json), record-model refined in R3.Q1. Recommended-default deferrals (취소 되돌리기, 무입금 환불표시 억제) correctly recorded as assumptions, not laundered as decisions — clean on the eval-6 run-6 fabrication axis. Budget fully consumed 3/3 → tag correctly CLARIFICATION CAPPED with Still Open carrying genuine un-asked material axes — clean on the eval-8 run-1 false-COMPLETE axis. 16/16, rubric 10/10; sits with the eval-6 run-1 anchor. The only interpretive call is assertion 8's 'traces to an asked question' clause, resolved PASS because assertion 16 and rubric D3 explicitly require the no-login fact be territory-derived, not re-asked.
